story: Nora wanted to eat the bread, but a puppy shivered on a high ledge. Nora said, “The puppy needs help.” Dad said, “I can lower the basket.” Nora said, “I can share the bread.” Nora put the bread in the basket. Dad carried the basket to the window, and he lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Nora waited because the puppy was frightened. The puppy entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Dad lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Nora carried the puppy into the cottage, and she wrapped the puppy in the warm blanket. Nora was hungry, but the puppy rested in the warm blanket.

qa.answer: The puppy ate the bread that Nora had meant to eat. It rested in the warm blanket after the rescue.
